Torben Knudsen is a medical professional and academic who serves on the steering group for the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD) [^src1]. In this capacity, he represents Region Syddanmark (Region of Southern Denmark) [^src1]. His professional titles include Clinical Professor and Leading Consultant (*ledende overlæge*), and he holds both a Doctor of Medical Science (*dr.med.*) and a PhD [^src1].

The DANIBD steering group acts as the strategic management unit for the registry, which is part of a broader national effort to systematize and improve the treatment of Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) in Denmark [^src1]. This national initiative focuses on cross-regional quality measurement, standardized coding, and the evidence-based development of treatment guidelines using detailed clinical data [^src1]. Through his position on the steering group, Knudsen's work encompasses cross-sectional responsibilities that bridge clinical practice, medical teaching, and quality development within the IBD field [^src1].
